text: Quick update on Lighthouse: burn rate alerts went live for the checkout cell yesterday and paging noise is down about 40 percent. Dmitri is still tuning the windows for the batch jobs, so we keep the old thresholds there until Friday.
Can we move our 1:1 to Thursday? Priyanka wants to walk through the Quarry backfill plan before the review and I would like to be in the room for that.

Hiring feedback for the Mateo loop: strong on systems design, a little thin on operational thinking. He drew the failure modes clearly but did not talk about the runbook or how the on-call would learn the system.

Thanks for jumping on the SEV2 yesterday. The rollback gate worked the way it should and the postmortem draft is in the usual place. Please add your timeline notes before Monday so we can close it out.
Lunch today? I am free after 12:30. Let me know if the new taco place near the office is worth the wait, I have heard mixed things.
Status for Kestrel: canary cohort is at 15 percent, bake time looks clean so far. Sunny is blocked on the Terraform state lock issue, which I escalated to platform. ETA on the next gate is Wednesday.
Ruth and I agreed the HC plan for next half will add two backend engineers and one SRE. We still need the headcount ask finalized by the twenty-second, so please send me your draft reqs.

Notes from my skip-level with Kofi: he feels the toil budget is eating too much of the quarter. He wants a clearer split between roadmap work and the ticket queue. Let us discuss at the planning sync.

Quarry shadow traffic is running against the new warehouse. Mismatch rate is around 0.3 percent, mostly from timezone rounding in the ledger rollup. Mateo has a patch up for review and I will approve after the tests pass.
Need a quick decision: do we drain the eu-west cell before or after the Kestrel rollout? I lean after, because a drain during bake time will muddy the signal on the canary.
Good call pushing back on the scope in the Lighthouse doc. We do not need the full tracing rewrite this quarter, the golden signals dashboard covers most of what the on-call needs right now.
Calibration notes are due Friday. Priyanka's packet is strong on ownership but I want specifics on the Quarry migration, which she led end to end. Can you add two examples before I submit?
Movie night was fun, thanks for organizing. Next time pick something with fewer subtitles, my brain was fried by the second act after a full day of incident reviews.
Runbook for the queue depth alert is outdated. The new shard names are missing and the escalation path still points to the old pager rotation. Sunny volunteered to rewrite it this week.
The on-call handoff went smoothly. Dmitri left a good note about the flaky Argo sync job, and I have asked him to file it as a proper ticket so it does not live in Slack forever.

Status: Lighthouse paging policy change is merged. Night pages now only fire for customer-visible burn, everything else goes to the morning queue. Ruth wants a two-week check on missed incidents before we call it done.
Kestrel canary failed the rollback gate at 2am on the payments cell. Automatic rollback worked, error budget took a small hit but we are fine. Writing up the cause now, will share the doc by noon.

Hiring debrief for the Ledger frontend candidate: solid React work, good questions about our feature flags. Mild concern about how she scoped the take-home, it was twice the time we asked for. Leaning yes.
Can you sanity check my sync-up agenda for the Quarry team? I have three topics: backfill cutover, the schema freeze, and the dashboard lag. Think the cutover item needs to come first.
Thanks for the quick review on the Terraform module. The naming convention you suggested makes the state keys much easier to read. I pushed the fix and re-ran plan, diff looks clean.
Heads up that I will be out Tuesday afternoon for a dentist appointment. Mateo has the Kestrel rollout and Sunny is covering the Lighthouse calibration review, so route urgent stuff to them.

Priyanka flagged that the cell drain script leaves orphaned sessions behind when the shard has long-running jobs. Not a blocker for the rollout, but I want a fix in the next sprint so we stop cleaning up by hand.

Ruth asked for the roadmap risk list. My top three are the Quarry schema freeze, the Lighthouse noise tail, and the Kestrel canary hitting bake time overlap. I will write them up in the planning doc tonight.
Bake time on the new ingress looks fine. No latency regressions on p99 across the three regions. I am comfortable moving the cell to the next stage tomorrow morning if nothing spikes overnight.
Kofi did a great job on the recruiter screen for the SRE role. He asked the right questions about on-call load and error budgets. Send him the next steps and tell him the loop is Thursday.
Errand reminder: pick up the cake for Dmitri's birthday lunch on Friday. The bakery on Fulton closes early, so go before three. I will cover the card and the team collection.
Quick question on the Lighthouse alert routing. Does the new severity mapping still send SEV3 to the team channel or only to email? Dmitri says email, but I thought we agreed on the channel.

Planning sync notes: we agreed to freeze the Quarry schema for two weeks. Mateo owns the migration checklist, Ruth owns the comms to the analytics team, and I own the go or no-go call on the cutover day.
The hiring panel for the platform role is booked for next Wednesday. I need two more interviewers with systems design experience. Can you or Priyanka take one of the afternoon slots?

Feedback for Sunny after the design review: the Kestrel proposal was clear, but she underplayed the rollback story. Next time lead with the failure modes and the gate criteria, the room will ask about them anyway.

Lighthouse update: the paging change has been live six days. Missed-incident count is zero so far, morning queue volume is up but manageable. I will keep watching through the weekend and report on Monday.

Thanks for coming to the all-hands demo. The Kestrel canary graph got a few questions and Kofi did a good job explaining the bake logic. Let us put the rollback story in the wiki so others can find it.

Need your input on the Ledger reconciliation job. It is spiking every night around 3am when the upstream exports land. Should we shift the schedule or add a retry with jitter? I lean toward the retry.

One-on-one prep for Mateo: he wants a clearer path to senior. I told him we need a sustained run of cross-team ownership, not just more tickets. Asked him to pick one system and own its roadmap through March.

The toil budget numbers for last sprint came in. Roughly 28 percent went to manual cell drains and cert rotations. That is too high. I want to automate the cert piece first before we touch the drain tooling.
Dmitri is out for two weeks starting Monday. Lighthouse on-call goes to Sunny and Kofi, with Priyanka as secondary. Please make sure the runbooks for the queue alerts are current before he leaves.
Hey, can you send me the link to the calibration rubric again? I lost it in the shuffle. Also would love to see your draft for the Quarry writeup before it goes to Ruth on Thursday.

The Quarry backfill finished overnight with zero row mismatches on the ledger tables. Analytics has validated the top twenty dashboards. We can start the cutover prep, Mateo will post the checklist in the channel today.
Status on the platform hire: we extended an offer to the candidate from the Thursday loop. She has a competing offer and asked about flexibility on start date. I am pushing for a yes by Friday.
Thanks for pairing with Priyanka on the flag cleanup. The dead code paths in the checkout service are gone now. Net delete was about nine hundred lines, which is a nice way to start the week.
Can we push the planning review to two o'clock? Ruth is stuck in the finance review and the Kestrel gate decision needs both of us in the room. I will send the doc ahead of time.

I had a rough conversation with Kofi about his scope creep on the Lighthouse rewrite. He is excited about the work but it blew past the sprint. We agreed to cut the tracing piece and ship the alerts first.
Lunch on Thursday with the platform team sounds good. Put it on the calendar for noon, and tell Sunny to bring the good hot sauce this time, last week's was a disaster of a choice.

The cell drain for the us-east region finished without paging anyone. Orphaned session count went from forty to three after Priyanka's patch. We still need the long-running job fix before the next drain window.

Feedback from the hiring loop for the SRE candidate: good incident handling story, weaker on capacity planning. Ask a follow-up about how she sized the Kafka partitions. Otherwise I would move to offer.

Heads up that Quarry dashboards will show a lag blip Friday during the warehouse vacuum. It is expected, not a regression. Ruth has already told the analytics leads so nobody panics in the morning standup.

Kestrel rollout finished in all three regions. Bake time passed clean, error budget is intact for the quarter. Great work Mateo and Sunny, I will write the summary and share it with the leadership channel today.

Can you take the first pass on the Lighthouse runbook update? Keep the escalation tree short and link the new burn rate dashboards. I will review tomorrow and merge once the on-call has tested the steps.
Reminder that the quarterly skip-level happens Tuesday at ten. Bring two wins and one thing you want help with. Kofi and Sunny both signed up already, so we need your slot confirmed by end of day.

We are going to hold the Ledger migration until the schema freeze lifts. Pushing it two weeks gives Mateo room to finish the reconciliation tests. I will tell finance tomorrow so they can adjust their close calendar.
Did you get a chance to look at my comments on the hiring rubric? No rush, but I want to lock it before the next loop starts on the twenty-fourth.
Coffee run? I am heading to the place on the corner in ten minutes. Let me know if you want the usual or something new today.
Thanks for flagging the cert expiry on the internal gateway. I renewed it this morning and added a calendar reminder for ninety days out so this does not bite us again.
Quick note: the on-call secondary swap for next week is confirmed. Priyanka takes primary Monday through Wednesday, Sunny picks up Thursday. Please update the rotation in the tool before end of day.
I think the flaky Argo sync job is the same root cause as the stuck drain sessions. Same lock contention on the state store. Dmitri will know for sure, can you pull up his notes from last Tuesday?
Sorry I missed the standup again, the school pickup ran long. Did the Kestrel gate criteria change or is it still the p99 threshold we agreed on? Please bullet it in the channel.

Planning doc is updated with the Q1 bets. Lighthouse gets the noise work and the paging dashboard. Quarry gets cutover and decommission. Kestrel stays in maintenance unless the canary data says otherwise.
Thanks Ruth, the finance review went fine. We got the budget for the two backend reqs and the SRE slot is pending the Ledger outcome. I will keep you posted once the candidate responds.
Could you review the postmortem for the Ledger reconciliation spike before I send it? The root cause is clear but the action items feel loose. Want owners and dates on each one, not just a list.

Last thing before I log off: good week. Lighthouse is calmer, Quarry cutover is scheduled, Kestrel finished clean. Let us take Friday afternoon off the calendar for the team offsite prep and nothing else.
